item.title: IEEE P2881 - Standard for Learning Metadata
item.author: emecas
item.description:
IEEE P2881 - Standard for Learning Metadata Working Group
https://sagroups.ieee.org/2881/
Sponsoring Society and Standards Committee: IEEE Computer Society/ Learning Technology Standards Committee (C/LTSC)

Title:
Standard for Learning Metadata

Scope:
This standard intentionally builds on the IEEE 1484.12.1 standard but is explorative to new learning paradigms and modern technology practices.
This standard will specify a conceptual data schema that defines the structure of a metadata instance.
This conceptual data schema specifies the data elements which compose a metadata instance for multiple learning types.
This standard does not define how a learning technology system implements the data schema.
